sources.entry: CodeRunner - Lightweight, multi-language programming text editor and IDE.

summary.name: CodeRunner
summary.one_liner: CodeRunner 4 is a lightweight multi-language text editor and IDE for macOS that runs code in 25 built-in languages and offers debugging, linting and code completion.
use_cases: running code snippets in many languages on a Mac
debugging programs with breakpoints and stepping
searching and replacing across project folders
editing many text files with a Vim-style workflow
summary.what_it_does: CodeRunner runs code in 25 languages out of the box, and other languages can be added by entering their terminal command. It provides code completion with fuzzy search and documentation snippets, plus breakpoint debugging in more than a dozen languages using debuggers such as lldb, jdb, pdb and node. Live error checking shows syntax and linter issues inline, and compile or runtime errors from the console are added to the document. The editor includes multiple selections, auto-indent, TextMate-based syntax highlighting with over 200 modes, Vim mode, customizable key bindings, and find and replace with regular expressions.
notable: Runs 25 languages out of the box and accepts custom languages via terminal command
Breakpoint debugging with call stack and variable inspection using lldb, jdb, pdb, node and other debuggers
Multiple selections, Vim mode and TextMate syntaxes and themes
Version 4 adds inline linting and error checking, plus new code tokenizers for symbol renaming
caveats: Some languages have only basic or coming-soon code completion and no debugger support
Mac App Store buyers must generate a license key to use the website version
